name: askif-monorepo
description: Let Jev decide. Monorepo for askif and its backend packages.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter askif run build && pnpm --filter @askif/jev run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter askif run typecheck && pnpm --filter askif run build && pnpm --filter @askif/jev run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter askif run build && pnpm --filter askif run test && pnpm --filter @askif/jev run test
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run docs:check
